haven't noticed—we are currently at war.|A female baggage attendant at Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport to Jai Maruk|}} '''Druckenwell''' was an industrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]], on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] world, it was loyal to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was best known for a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] weapons manufacturing complex that was located there. ==Description== Druckenwell was located in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. An overcrowded urban world governed by corporate guilds, Druckenwell's several large [[City/Legends|cities]] and industrial regions were divided by vast oceans, and almost all of the planet's available land had been developed. As a result, great care was taken to reduce the risk of pollution and to protect the planet's few remaining resources. Druckenwell's 9.3 billion inhabitants were mostly workers for the massive corporations on-world. Druckenwell's cities were planned with social and corporate order in mind and had specific zones for different worker classes—blue-collar districts, business offices, industrial areas, and a handful of pleasant parks and gardens for the corporate elite. Couples could not legally marry until they could prove themselves financially self-sufficient. The capital city of [[Il Avali]] housed [[Happy's Landing]] tavern and the [[I'att Armament]] complex, where a personal shielding device to protect [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] armor from [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire was developed. Druckenwell was also home to the corporate offices for [[SGI Systems, Inc.]], a major producer of black-market [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] components. ==History== ===Old Republic era=== {{Quote|A decade ago, I served under Moff Broysc at the Battle of Druckenwell. Moff Broysc made a critical oversight that brought the fleet to the brink of complete defeat. I ignored his order and turned the tide to victory.|Captain Malavai Quinn, to the Empire's Wrath|{{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Quinn's Grudge}}}} In [[3653 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] an the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a major [[Battle of Druckenwell|battle]] occurred above the planet. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Broysc]], the Imperial commanding officer, made a critical mistake during the battle, but [[Malavai Quinn|one of his subordinates]] disobeyed the orders and returned the advantage to the Empire, resulting in a Republic defeat. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Druckenwell (New Sith Wars)|battle]] won by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. ===Clone Wars=== During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Druckenwell, already a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] world, was held by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] as a foundry world, a status it was keen to maintain. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] was [[Druckenwellian|from the world]], and so struggled to prove his loyalty when dealing with those unaware of his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] status. ===Imperial occupation=== {{Quote|Surely you've followed events at Glova, Glom Tho and Druckenwell? The Empire no longer exists, and its warlords are in retreat throughout the Trailing Sectors.|Senator Leia Organa, to Moff Quarsh Panaka|{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}}} During the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] early days, [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] and [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] cooperated in a [[Mission to Druckenwell|raid]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on Druckenwell, one of a string of hit-and-run attacks that also took in [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], and [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]] When [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Eisen Kerioth]] tried to claim the energy shield as his own invention just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|Tinian I'att]] (young heiress of the I'att Corporation) escaped with the shielding device components and fled Druckenwell with the help of [[Twilit Hearth]]'s musical band. Tinian's lover [[Daye Azur-Jamin]] managed to destroy the I'att Armament complex and its Imperial invaders, but was almost [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the effort. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Imperial officials nationalized SGI Systems, Incorporated along with several other [[Droid/Legends|droid]] corporations, giving them control of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] droid market. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Druckenwell had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The planet was [[Battle of Druckenwell (Galactic Civil War)|targeted]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the months following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. ===Later history=== {{Quote|I guess Druckenwell's gone, too?''"
"''And Falleen. They've reached Rodia. It's the heavy end of the hammer, pounding and pounding.|Jacen and Jaina Solo|}} Later a member state of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Druckenwell was [[Battle of Druckenwell (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the [[extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|attempt to conquer the galaxy]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. While a small percentage of the population was evacuated aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Chilastra]]'' and other ships, those left behind were forced into labor camps after offering up little resistance to the invaders. These individuals were tasked with dismantling Druckenwell's cities and using arable land to grow Yuuzhan Vong [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. Following the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|defeat]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Druckenwell was located in [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] space, and remained an Alliance member state during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between [[40 ABY/Legends|40]] and [[41 ABY]].
